collectionMethod: San Jose ArcGIS MapServer HTTPS JSON query on building-permit layers 7, 8, and 9. where WORKDESC = 'ReRoof', returnGeometry false, outFields *, ordered by OBJECTID, paged with resultOffset and resultRecordCount until exceededTransferLimit is false. Each feature is normalizeSanJoseArcgisFeature. All normalized ReRoof permits for one undashed APN go into one estimateParcelRoofAge call. FINALDATE is the terminal date. builtYear is null. Issue date is not a roof age.
